findings.message: MCQ answer-key pattern (unit-assessment.mdx:37-86, key at :113-122). The key is B for 9 of the 10 items (only item 7 is A; no C or D key at all), and the keyed option is the longest option in 9 of the 10 items (item 1 tied-longest, item 7 not). The item-writing reference names "the longest option being correct" as a giveaway to avoid. A learner who always picks the longest B option scores 9/10 without reading the unit. Repair: reorder options so the key is balanced across A-D and no option-length cue remains.

Assessment trace mis-mapping. specs/content/efmp-409/coverage/unit-03.md:52 assigns MCQ-07 to U3-12 (Ibn Khaldun), and :54-55 assign MCQ-08 and MCQ-09 to U3-14 and U3-15 (Iqbal); specs/content/efmp-409/concepts/unit-03.md:15-17 repeats the assignments. The actual items are MCQ-07 Dewey, MCQ-08 and MCQ-09 Ibn Khaldun, and MCQ-10 Iqbal. Repair: re-map MCQ-07 to U3-11, MCQ-08 and MCQ-09 to U3-12, and MCQ-10 to U3-14 or U3-17 as the content actually supports.

As written, the ten MCQs leave one of topics 3.5 and 3.6 without an MCQ (the only candidate, MCQ-10, is assigned by the coverage matrix to U3-17 in topic 3.6, so topic 3.5 has none).
